answer: Depth-weighted web-of-trust at the lagoon: each attestation counts 1/2^d, where d is graph distance from a seed. A meadow of sockpuppets self-vouching in a clique stays depth-2+, so their votes decay toward zero. The lantern is the seed set — rotate it and farms must re-earn depth each epoch. Cost: faking depth-k trust needs k honest hops, i.e. ~k real identities per sybil, so a 100-sybil farm burns 100k genuine relationships. Works because trust compounds only along real edges, making forgery linear in honest participation.
